"""Pydantic request/response contracts for the Living Studio sidecar API."""

from __future__ import annotations

from enum import Enum
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal, Union

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chat event types — the typed model for what the assistant sends.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

#: The status of a tool call in the conversation transcript.
ToolStatus = Literal["running", "ok", "error", "declined"]


class ToolApproval(BaseModel):
    """A write the agent is asking permission for."""

    id: str
    prompt: str


class ChatAttachment(BaseModel):
    """One file attached to a message, as the assistant-ui model sees it.

    ``ChatAttachment`` carries the full payload (data URL or extracted text).
    ``AttachmentRef`` is the lighter reference embedded in a tool call's
    arguments to point at an already-uploaded file by id.
    """

    id: str
    name: str = ""
    content_type: str = "application/octet-stream"
    size: int | None = None
    text: str | None = None
    data_url: str | None = None


# --- ChatPart discriminated union -------------------------------------------


class TextPart(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["text"] = "text"
    text: str


class ReasoningPart(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["reasoning"] = "reasoning"
    text: str


class SourcePart(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["source"] = "source"
    id: str
    title: str
    filename: str | None = None
    media_type: str


class ToolPart(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["tool"] = "tool"
    id: str
    name: str
    status: ToolStatus
    preview: str | None = None
    approval: ToolApproval | None = None


class SurfacePart(BaseModel):
    """A rich surface rendered inline in the transcript (``kind: "ui"``)."""

    kind: Literal["surface"] = "surface"
    id: str
    spec: dict[str, Any]


class ErrorPart(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["error"] = "error"
    code: str
    message: str


ChatPart = Annotated[
    Union[TextPart, ReasoningPart, SourcePart, ToolPart, SurfacePart, ErrorPart],
    Field(discriminator="kind"),
]


class ChatMessage(BaseModel):
    """One message in the conversation thread."""

    role: Literal["system", "user", "assistant", "tool"]
    content: str = ""
    #: Stable id for this turn, so a branch survives a reload. Clients that do
    #: not send one are persisted in a linear chain instead.
    id: str | None = None
    parent_id: str | None = None
    #: Prose and surfaces in the order the agent produced them, so a card sits
    #: between the paragraphs that frame it. ``content`` stays the combined
    #: prose because that is what gets replayed as history.
    parts: list[ChatPart] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def attachments(self) -> list[ChatAttachment]:
        """Attachments are carried on the request, not the message.

        Kept as a convenience property for API compatibility so callers that
        inspect ``message.attachments`` always get a list, never an error.
        """
        return []


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request / response models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class McpHealthRequest(BaseModel):
    mcp_url: str


class LlmHealthRequest(BaseModel):
    base_url: str
    api_key: str = ""
    model: str = ""


class ModelsRequest(BaseModel):
    """Which backend to ask for its model ids. The key travels in the body, not
    the query string, so it never lands in a URL or an access log."""

    base_url: str
    api_key: str = ""


class AddStepRequest(BaseModel):
    mcp_url: str
    job_id: str
    name: str
    order: int


class AddOutcomeRequest(BaseModel):
    mcp_url: str
    job_id: str
    statement: str
    importance: float
    satisfaction: float


class CreateJobRequest(BaseModel):
    """Create a Job by hand, with or without the model."""

    name: str = Field(min_length=1)
    description: str | None = None
    mcp_url: str = ""


class UpdateJobRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    mcp_url: str = ""


class UpdateStepRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = None
    order: int | None = None
    mcp_url: str = ""


class UpdateOutcomeRequest(BaseModel):
    statement: str | None = None
    importance: float | None = None
    satisfaction: float | None = None
    mcp_url: str = ""


class StudioBrief(BaseModel):
    """The user's context, captured during first-run onboarding."""

    product_name: str = ""
    product_url: str = ""
    target_user: str = ""
    job_statement: str = ""
    core_problem: str = ""


class UiCatalogRequest(BaseModel):
    """What the calling client can render. Omitted by non-visual clients."""

    version: int = 1
    components: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AttachmentRef(BaseModel):
    """One file the user attached to a turn.

    Nothing is stored server-side: an attachment is part of the message. Text is
    extracted by the client because only the client has the file; images arrive
    as data URLs for backends that accept them.
    """

    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=255)
    content_type: str = "application/octet-stream"
    size: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    text: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=80_000)
    data_url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=8_000_000)


class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    base_url: str
    api_key: str = ""
    model: str
    mcp_url: str
    messages: list[ChatMessage] = Field(default_factory=list)
    brief: StudioBrief | None = None
    ui_catalog: UiCatalogRequest | None = None
    conversation_id: str | None = None
    attachments: list[AttachmentRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
    #: Ask before a tool writes. Off by default so the CLI and older clients keep
    #: their current, unprompted behaviour.
    approvals: bool = False
    #: The id the client is streaming this reply under, so the persisted branch
    #: tree matches the one on screen.
    assistant_id: str | None = None


class ApprovalDecisionRequest(BaseModel):
    approved: bool
    reason: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)


class ApprovalDecisionResponse(BaseModel):
    ok: bool
    id: str


class AddConnectorRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = None
    preset: str | None = None
    url: str | None = None


class ConnectorListItem(BaseModel):
    name: str
    kind: str
    enabled: bool = True


class ConnectorOperationResponse(BaseModel):
    ok: bool
    name: str


ObservationKind = Literal[
    "career",
    "opportunity",
    "business",
    "stakeholder",
    "constraint",
    "evidence",
    "preference",
]
ObservationStatus = Literal["suggested", "confirmed", "dismissed"]


class ObservationModel(BaseModel):
    id: str
    kind: str
    text: str
    data: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    status: str
    confidence: float
    source_turn: int | None = None
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str


class ObservationListResponse(BaseModel):
    observations: list[ObservationModel]


class ObservationResponse(BaseModel):
    observation: ObservationModel


class ObservationCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    kind: ObservationKind
    text: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.6, ge=0, le=1)
    confirmed: bool = False


class ObservationUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    status: ObservationStatus | None = None
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    confidence: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Conversation / turn models — branching support
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ConversationModel(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    head_id: str | None = None


class ConversationResponse(BaseModel):
    conversation: ConversationModel


class TurnModel(BaseModel):
    id: int
    conversation_id: str
    role: str
    content: str
    created_at: str
    message_id: str | None = None
    parent_id: str | None = None


class LatestConversationResponse(BaseModel):
    conversation: ConversationModel | None = None
    turns: list[TurnModel] = Field(default_factory=list)


class TurnNode(BaseModel):
    """One turn in the branch tree, as the thread runtime needs it."""

    id: str
    parent_id: str | None = None
    role: str
    content: str
    created_at: str


class ConversationTreeResponse(BaseModel):
    conversation: ConversationModel
    messages: list[TurnNode] = Field(default_factory=list)
    head_id: str | None = None


class UpdateConversationRequest(BaseModel):
    head_id: str | None = None
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SSE event types — the typed shapes of what the stream emits
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ChatEventType(str, Enum):
    """Event types that map to chat-message parts in the SSE stream."""

    message = "message"
    tool = "tool"
    source = "source"
    reasoning = "reasoning"
    approval = "approval"


class StreamMessageEvent(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["message"] = ChatEventType.message.value
    content: str


class StreamToolEvent(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["tool"] = ChatEventType.tool.value
    id: str
    name: str
    status: ToolStatus
    preview: str | None = None
    approval: ToolApproval | None = None


class StreamSourceEvent(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["source"] = ChatEventType.source.value
    id: str
    title: str
    filename: str | None = None
    media_type: str


class StreamReasoningEvent(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["reasoning"] = ChatEventType.reasoning.value
    text: str


class StreamApprovalEvent(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["approval"] = ChatEventType.approval.value
    id: str
    tool_call_id: str
    name: str
    arguments: dict[str, Any]
    prompt: str


StreamEvent = Annotated[
    Union[
        StreamMessageEvent,
        StreamToolEvent,
        StreamSourceEvent,
        StreamReasoningEvent,
        StreamApprovalEvent,
    ],
    Field(discriminator="type"),
]

"""Tests for the Living Studio's local memory store."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterator

import pytest
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.memory import (
    OBSERVATION_KINDS,
    ConversationNotFoundError,
    ObservationNotFoundError,
    StudioMemory,
    default_db_path,
)


@pytest.fixture()
def memory() -> Iterator[StudioMemory]:
    store = StudioMemory(":memory:")
    yield store
    store.close()


def test_create_conversation_starts_untitled(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()
    assert conversation.id
    assert conversation.title == ""
    assert memory.latest_conversation() == conversation


def test_first_user_turn_names_the_conversation(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "user", "  I own activation for self-serve trials  ")
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "assistant", "Tell me where it breaks.")

    latest = memory.latest_conversation()
    assert latest is not None
    assert latest.id == conversation.id
    assert latest.title == "I own activation for self-serve trials"


def test_assistant_turn_does_not_replace_the_title(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "user", "First message")
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "assistant", "Reply")
    latest = memory.latest_conversation()
    assert latest is not None
    assert latest.title == "First message"


def test_turns_round_trip_in_order(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "user", "one")
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "assistant", "two")

    turns = memory.list_turns(conversation.id)
    assert [turn.role for turn in turns] == ["user", "assistant"]
    assert [turn.content for turn in turns] == ["one", "two"]


def test_unknown_conversation_is_rejected(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConversationNotFoundError):
        memory.append_turn("missing", "user", "hello")
    with pytest.raises(ConversationNotFoundError):
        memory.list_turns("missing")


def test_add_observation_defaults_to_suggested(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    observation = memory.add_observation("career", "Wants to be known for activation.")
    assert observation.status == "suggested"
    assert observation.confidence == 0.5
    assert observation.data == {}
    assert memory.list_observations() == [observation]


def test_observation_kinds_are_validated(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        memory.add_observation("nonsense", "text")
    assert "career" in OBSERVATION_KINDS


def test_observation_text_must_be_present(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        memory.add_observation("career", "   ")


def test_observations_round_trip_data(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    observation = memory.add_observation(
        "opportunity", "Activation is stuck.", data={"job_id": "job-1"}, confidence=0.8
    )
    stored = memory.list_observations()[0]
    assert stored.id == observation.id
    assert stored.data == {"job_id": "job-1"}
    assert stored.confidence == 0.8


def test_dismissed_observations_are_hidden_by_default(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    keep = memory.add_observation("business", "Growth is the mandate.")
    drop = memory.add_observation("business", "A wrong guess.")
    memory.update_observation(drop.id, status="dismissed")

    assert [item.id for item in memory.list_observations()] == [keep.id]
    assert len(memory.list_observations(include_dismissed=True)) == 2


def test_update_observation_fields(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    observation = memory.add_observation("constraint", "Approval is slow.")
    updated = memory.update_observation(
        observation.id, text="Legal review is slow.", status="confirmed", confidence=0.9
    )
    assert updated.text == "Legal review is slow."
    assert updated.status == "confirmed"
    assert updated.confidence == 0.9


def test_update_unknown_observation_is_rejected(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ObservationNotFoundError):
        memory.update_observation("missing", status="confirmed")


def test_delete_observation(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    observation = memory.add_observation("preference", "Prefers short updates.")
    memory.delete_observation(observation.id)
    assert memory.list_observations() == []
    with pytest.raises(ObservationNotFoundError):
        memory.delete_observation(observation.id)


def test_memory_context_marks_status(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    memory.add_observation("career", "Owns activation.", status="confirmed")
    memory.add_observation("constraint", "Legal review is slow.")
    memory.add_observation("business", "Ignore this.", status="dismissed")

    context = memory.memory_context()
    assert "Owns activation." in context
    assert "Legal review is slow." in context
    assert "Ignore this." not in context
    assert "confirmed" in context


def test_memory_context_caps_suggestions(memory: StudioMemory) -> None:
    memory.add_observation("career", "confirmed fact", status="confirmed")
    for index in range(15):

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3

def test_turns_keep_the_client_message_ids() -> None:
    memory = _memory()
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()

    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "user", "list jobs", "m-1", None)
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "assistant", "here they are", "m-2", "m-1")

    turns = memory.list_turns(conversation.id)
    assert [(turn.message_id, turn.parent_id) for turn in turns] == [
        ("m-1", None),
        ("m-2", "m-1"),
    ]
    assert memory.get_conversation(conversation.id).head_id == "m-2"  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def test_a_second_answer_to_the_same_question_is_a_sibling() -> None:
    memory = _memory()
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()

    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "user", "list jobs", "m-1", None)
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "assistant", "first", "m-2", "m-1")
    memory.append_turn(conversation.id, "assistant", "second", "m-3", "m-1")

    parents = {
        turn.message_id: turn.parent_id for turn in memory.conversation_tree(conversation.id)
    }
    assert parents == {"m-1": None, "m-2": "m-1", "m-3": "m-1"}

    memory.set_head(conversation.id, "m-2")
    assert memory.get_conversation(conversation.id).head_id == "m-2"  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def test_legacy_rows_are_read_as_a_linear_chain(tmp_path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "studio.db"
    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    connection.executescript(
        """
        CREATE TABLE conversations (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE turns (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL,
            content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        INSERT INTO conversations VALUES ('c1', 'Old', 'now', 'now');
        INSERT INTO turns (conversation_id, role, content, created_at)
            VALUES ('c1', 'user', 'hello', 'now');
        INSERT INTO turns (conversation_id, role, content, created_at)
            VALUES ('c1', 'assistant', 'hi', 'now');
        """
    )
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()

    memory = StudioMemory(path)
    turns = memory.conversation_tree("c1")

    assert [(turn.message_id, turn.parent_id) for turn in turns] == [
        ("turn-1", None),
        ("turn-2", "turn-1"),
    ]
    assert memory.get_conversation("c1").head_id is None  # type: ignore[union-attr]

"""FastAPI app for the Living Studio sidecar."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from agentic_odi_core import ODIService
from agentic_odi_core.messages import CAPABILITIES
from agentic_odi_core.remote import StudioError, StudioErrorCode
from agentic_odi_core.repository import Repository
from agentic_odi_core.sqlite_repository import SQLiteRepository
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.approvals import ApprovalRegistry
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.connectors import ConnectorService
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.errors import (
    RequestIdMiddleware,
    StudioHTTPError,
    register_error_handlers,
    request_id_for,
)
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.memory import StudioMemory
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.router import router as studio_router

CORS_ORIGINS = [
    "tauri://localhost",
    "http://tauri.localhost",
    "http://localhost:5173",
    "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
    "http://localhost:8100",
    "http://127.0.0.1:8100",
]

DEFAULT_BACKEND = "local"


def default_spa_dist() -> Path:
    """Resolve the built SPA, preferring an explicit override."""
    configured = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_STUDIO_DIST")
    if configured:
        return Path(configured)
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "apps" / "studio" / "dist"


SPA_DIST = default_spa_dist()


def create_app(
    repo: Repository | None = None,
    backend: str | None = None,
    connectors: ConnectorService | None = None,
    memory: StudioMemory | None = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    if repo is None:
        repo = SQLiteRepository()
    service = ODIService(repo)
    # Pending write approvals live for the life of the process: a local sidecar
    # serves one person and has no durable run state to resume into.
    approvals = ApprovalRegistry()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        yield
        # Nothing may outlive the process waiting on a decision.
        approvals.cancel_all()

    app = FastAPI(
        title="Agentic ODI Studio API",
        openapi_url="/api/openapi.json",
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )
    app.state.service = service
    app.state.backend = backend or os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_BACKEND") or DEFAULT_BACKEND
    app.state.connectors = connectors or ConnectorService()
    app.state.memory = memory or StudioMemory()
    app.state.approvals = approvals

    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=CORS_ORIGINS,
        allow_credentials=False,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )
    app.add_middleware(RequestIdMiddleware)
    register_error_handlers(app)

    @app.get("/health")
    def health() -> dict:
        return {"status": "ok"}

    @app.get("/capabilities")
    def capabilities() -> dict:
        return {"capabilities": CAPABILITIES}

    app.include_router(studio_router)

    if SPA_DIST.is_dir() and not os.getenv("AGENTIC_ODI_DISABLE_SPA"):
        assets_dir = SPA_DIST / "assets"
        if assets_dir.is_dir():
            app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=assets_dir), name="assets")

        @app.get("/{full_path:path}", response_model=None)
        def spa_fallback(request: Request, full_path: str) -> FileResponse | JSONResponse:
            if full_path == "api" or full_path.startswith("api/"):
                raise StudioHTTPError(
                    StudioError(code=StudioErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message="Not Found")
                )
            candidate = (SPA_DIST / full_path).resolve()
            if full_path and candidate.is_file() and candidate.is_relative_to(SPA_DIST.resolve()):
                return FileResponse(candidate)
            index = SPA_DIST / "index.html"
            if index.is_file():
                return FileResponse(index)
            error = StudioError(
                code=StudioErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,
                message="Not Found",
                request_id=request_id_for(request),
            )
            return JSONResponse({"error": error.model_dump(mode="json")}, status_code=404)

    return app

"""The turn's new parts: thinking, provenance, write approval, and attachments."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio import chat
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.approvals import (
    ApprovalDecision,
    ApprovalRegistry,
)
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.schemas import AttachmentRef, ChatMessage, ChatRequest


def _request(**overrides: Any) -> ChatRequest:
    values: dict[str, Any] = {
        "base_url": "http://llm/v1",
        "api_key": "key",
        "model": "model",
        "mcp_url": "http://mcp",
        "messages": [ChatMessage(role="user", content="list jobs", id="m-1")],
    }
    values.update(overrides)
    return ChatRequest(**values)


class _FakeStream:
    def __init__(self, chunks: list[Any]) -> None:
        self._chunks = chunks

    def __aiter__(self) -> Any:
        async def _gen() -> Any:
            for chunk in self._chunks:
                yield chunk

        return _gen()


class _Completions:
    def __init__(self, streams: list[_FakeStream]) -> None:
        self._streams = streams

    async def create(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _FakeStream:
        return self._streams.pop(0)


class _FakeOpenAI:
    def __init__(self, streams: list[_FakeStream], **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=_Completions(streams))


class _Mcp:
    calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
    tool_result: str = "ok"

    def __init__(self, url: str) -> None:
        self.url = url

    async def __aenter__(self) -> _Mcp:
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *exc: Any) -> bool:
        return False

    async def list_tools(self) -> list[Any]:
        return [
            SimpleNamespace(
                name="add_job",
                description="Create a job",
                input_schema={"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}},
            ),
            SimpleNamespace(
                name="get_jobs",
                description="List jobs",
                input_schema={"type": "object", "properties": {}},
            ),
        ]

    async def call_tool(self, name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        _Mcp.calls.append((name, arguments))
        return _Mcp.tool_result


def _chunk(
    content: str | None = None,
    tool_calls: list[Any] | None = None,
    reasoning: str | None = None,
) -> Any:
    delta = SimpleNamespace(
        content=content,
        tool_calls=tool_calls,
        reasoning_content=reasoning,
    )
    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(delta=delta)])


def _tool_call(arguments: str, name: str = "get_jobs") -> Any:
    return SimpleNamespace(
        index=0,
        id="call-1",
        function=SimpleNamespace(name=name, arguments=arguments),
    )


def _install(monkeypatch, streams: list[_FakeStream]) -> None:
    async def _healthy(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        return True, "ok"

    _Mcp.calls = []
    _Mcp.tool_result = "ok"
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "check_llm_health", _healthy)
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "McpClient", _Mcp)
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "is_endpoint_reachable", lambda url, timeout: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "AsyncOpenAI", lambda **kwargs: _FakeOpenAI(streams, **kwargs))


def _parse(frames: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    events: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for frame in frames:
        name = None
        data = None
        for line in frame.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("event: "):
                name = line[len("event: ") :]
            elif line.startswith("data: "):
                data = line[len("data: ") :]
        if name and data is not None:
            events.append((name, json.loads(data)))
    return events


def _collect(request: ChatRequest, approvals: ApprovalRegistry | None = None) -> list[str]:
    async def _run() -> list[str]:
        return [frame async for frame in chat.stream_chat(request, approvals=approvals)]

    return asyncio.run(_run())


def _collect_answering(
    request: ChatRequest,
    approvals: ApprovalRegistry,
    decision: ApprovalDecision,
) -> list[str]:
    """Consume the turn, answering the first approval gate that appears."""

    async def _run() -> list[str]:
        frames: list[str] = []
        async for frame in chat.stream_chat(request, approvals=approvals):
            frames.append(frame)
            if frame.startswith("event: approval"):
                payload = json.loads(frame.split("data: ", 1)[1])
                approvals.resolve(payload["id"], decision)
        return frames

    return asyncio.run(_run())


def test_reasoning_is_streamed_separately_from_the_answer(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(reasoning="weighing options"), _chunk(content="Done.")]),
        ],
    )

    events = _parse(_collect(_request()))

    kinds = [name for name, _ in events]
    assert "reasoning" in kinds
    reasoning = next(data for name, data in events if name == "reasoning")
    assert reasoning["text"] == "weighing options"
    # Thinking is never part of the answer that replays as history.
    message = next(data for name, data in events if name == "message")
    assert message["content"] == "Done."


def test_a_tool_that_returned_data_becomes_a_source(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call("{}")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk(content="One job.")]),
        ],
    )
    _Mcp.tool_result = '[{"id": "JOB-1", "name": "Retention"}]'

    events = _parse(_collect(_request()))

    sources = [data for name, data in events if name == "source"]
    assert len(sources) == 1
    assert sources[0]["filename"] == "get_jobs"
    assert sources[0]["title"].startswith("get_jobs — ")
    assert "Retention" in sources[0]["title"]
    assert sources[0]["mediaType"] == "application/json"


def test_a_failed_tool_produces_no_source(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call("{}")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk(content="No such job.")]),
        ],
    )
    _Mcp.tool_result = "Error: Job with ID JOB-1 not found."

    events = _parse(_collect(_request()))

    assert not [data for name, data in events if name == "source"]


def test_the_approval_gate_does_not_appear_without_the_flag(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call('{"name":"Retention"}', "add_job")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk(content="Added.")]),
        ],
    )

    events = _parse(_collect(_request()))

    assert not [data for name, data in events if name == "approval"]
    assert _Mcp.calls == [("add_job", {"name": "Retention"})]


def test_an_approved_write_runs(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call('{"name":"Retention"}', "add_job")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk(content="Added.")]),
        ],
    )
    registry = ApprovalRegistry()

    frames = _collect_answering(_request(approvals=True), registry, ApprovalDecision(approved=True))
    events = _parse(frames)

    approval = next(data for name, data in events if name == "approval")
    assert approval["name"] == "add_job"
    assert approval["arguments"] == {"name": "Retention"}
    assert approval["prompt"] == "Allow the assistant to add job?"
    assert _Mcp.calls == [("add_job", {"name": "Retention"})]


def test_a_declined_write_never_runs_and_the_turn_still_ends(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call('{"name":"Retention"}', "add_job")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk(content="Understood, I left it alone.")]),
        ],
    )
    registry = ApprovalRegistry()

    frames = _collect_answering(
        _request(approvals=True),
        registry,
        ApprovalDecision(approved=False, reason="not yet"),
    )
    events = _parse(frames)

    assert _Mcp.calls == []
    declined = [data for name, data in events if name == "tool" and data["status"] == "declined"]
    assert len(declined) == 1
    assert "declined to run add_job" in declined[0]["preview"]
    assert "not yet" in declined[0]["preview"]
    terminals = [name for name, _ in events if name in {"message", "error"}]
    assert terminals == ["message"]


def test_an_expired_gate_tells_the_model_nothing_changed(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call('{"name":"Retention"}', "add_job")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk(content="I did not change anything.")]),
        ],
    )

    async def _expired(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "wait_for_decision", _expired)

    events = _parse(_collect(_request(approvals=True), approvals=ApprovalRegistry()))

    assert _Mcp.calls == []
    declined = [data for name, data in events if name == "tool" and data["status"] == "declined"]
    assert len(declined) == 1
    assert "expired" in declined[0]["preview"]
    assert [name for name, _ in events if name in {"message", "error"}] == ["message"]


def test_mutating_tools_are_named_by_prefix() -> None:
    assert chat.is_mutating_tool("add_job")
    assert chat.is_mutating_tool("delete_outcome")
    assert chat.is_mutating_tool("ingest_notion")
    assert not chat.is_mutating_tool("get_jobs")
    assert not chat.is_mutating_tool("remember")
    assert not chat.is_mutating_tool("render_ui")


def test_model_receives_visible_turn_history_in_order() -> None:
    request = _request(
        messages=[
            ChatMessage(role="user", content="Earlier question", id="m-1"),
            ChatMessage(role="assistant", content="Earlier answer", id="m-2"),
            ChatMessage(role="user", content="Latest question", id="m-3"),
        ]
    )

    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(request)

    assert messages[1:] == [
        {"role": "user", "content": "Earlier question"},
        {"role": "assistant", "content": "Earlier answer"},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Latest question"},
    ]


def test_attachment_text_is_part_of_the_user_turn_the_model_reads() -> None:
    request = _request(
        attachments=[
            AttachmentRef(
                name="call-notes.md",
                content_type="text/markdown",
                size=120,
                text="Customer said the export is too slow.",
            )
        ]
    )

    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(request)

def test_an_image_attachment_becomes_a_vision_part() -> None:
    request = _request(
        attachments=[
            AttachmentRef(
                name="whiteboard.png",
                content_type="image/png",
                size=2048,

"""Branch tests for the streaming tool loop in ``studio.chat``."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio import chat
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.connectors import ConnectorService
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.memory import StudioMemory
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.schemas import ChatMessage, ChatRequest


def _request() -> ChatRequest:
    return ChatRequest(
        base_url="http://llm/v1",
        api_key="key",
        model="model",
        mcp_url="http://mcp",
        messages=[ChatMessage(role="user", content="list jobs")],
    )


class _FakeStream:
    def __init__(self, chunks: list[Any]) -> None:
        self._chunks = chunks

    def __aiter__(self) -> Any:
        async def _gen() -> Any:
            for chunk in self._chunks:
                yield chunk

        return _gen()


class _Completions:
    def __init__(self, streams: list[_FakeStream]) -> None:
        self._streams = streams

    async def create(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _FakeStream:
        return self._streams.pop(0)


class _FakeOpenAI:
    def __init__(self, streams: list[_FakeStream], **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=_Completions(streams))


class _Mcp:
    error: Exception | None = None
    list_tools_error: Exception | None = None
    tool_result: str = "ok"
    calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []

    def __init__(self, url: str) -> None:
        self.url = url

    async def __aenter__(self) -> _Mcp:
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *exc: Any) -> bool:
        return False

    async def list_tools(self) -> list[Any]:
        if self.list_tools_error is not None:
            raise self.list_tools_error
        return [
            SimpleNamespace(
                name="get_jobs",
                description="List jobs",
                input_schema={"type": "object", "properties": {}},
            )
        ]

    async def call_tool(self, name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        self.calls.append((name, arguments))
        if self.error is not None:
            raise self.error
        return self.tool_result


def _chunk(content: str | None = None, tool_calls: list[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
    delta = SimpleNamespace(content=content, tool_calls=tool_calls)
    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(delta=delta)])


def _collect(request: ChatRequest, service: Any = None, request_id: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
    async def _run() -> list[str]:
        if service is None:
            return [chunk async for chunk in chat.stream_chat(request, request_id=request_id)]
        return [
            chunk
            async for chunk in chat.stream_chat(request, service=service, request_id=request_id)
        ]

    return asyncio.run(_run())


def _events(frames: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    events: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for frame in frames:
        name = None
        data = None
        for line in frame.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("event: "):
                name = line[len("event: ") :]
            elif line.startswith("data: "):
                data = line[len("data: ") :]
        if name and data is not None:
            events.setdefault(name, []).append(data)
    return events


def _install(monkeypatch, streams: list[_FakeStream]) -> None:
    async def _healthy(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        return True, "ok"

    _Mcp.calls = []
    _Mcp.error = None
    _Mcp.list_tools_error = None
    _Mcp.tool_result = "ok"
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "check_llm_health", _healthy)
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "McpClient", _Mcp)
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "is_endpoint_reachable", lambda url, timeout: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat, "AsyncOpenAI", lambda **kwargs: _FakeOpenAI(streams, **kwargs))


def _terminal_events(frames: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Return the terminal events of a stream, asserting there is exactly one."""
    events = _events(frames)
    terminals = []
    if "message" in events:
        terminals.extend(["message"] * len(events["message"]))
    if "error" in events:
        terminals.extend(["error"] * len(events["error"]))
    assert len(terminals) == 1, f"expected one terminal event, got {terminals}"
    return terminals


def _tool_call(arguments: str, name: str = "get_jobs") -> Any:
    return SimpleNamespace(
        index=0,
        id="call-1",
        function=SimpleNamespace(name=name, arguments=arguments),
    )


def test_retrying_a_persisted_question_does_not_duplicate_its_turn() -> None:
    memory = StudioMemory(":memory:")
    conversation = memory.create_conversation()

    chat._persist_turn(memory, conversation.id, "user", "list jobs", "user-1", None)
    chat._persist_turn(
        memory, conversation.id, "assistant", "first answer", "assistant-1", "user-1"
    )
    chat._persist_turn(memory, conversation.id, "user", "list jobs", "user-1", None)

    turns = memory.list_turns(conversation.id)
    assert [(turn.message_id, turn.role, turn.content) for turn in turns] == [
        ("user-1", "user", "list jobs"),
        ("assistant-1", "assistant", "first answer"),
    ]


def test_stream_chat_falls_back_to_empty_arguments_for_invalid_json(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream([_chunk(tool_calls=[_tool_call("not json")])]),
            _FakeStream([_chunk("done")]),
        ],
    )

    events = _events(_collect(_request()))

    assert _Mcp.calls == [("get_jobs", {})]
    assert json.loads(events["tool"][1])["status"] == "ok"


def test_stream_chat_reports_tool_call_failures(monkeypatch) -> None:

            _FakeStream([_chunk("recovered")]),
        ],
    )

    events = _events(_collect(_request()))

    failure = json.loads(events["tool"][1])
    assert failure["status"] == "error"
    assert "tool exploded" in failure["preview"]

def test_apply_add_connector_unknown_preset_emits_error(tmp_path) -> None:

def test_stream_chat_handles_add_connector_locally(monkeypatch, tmp_path) -> None:
    service = ConnectorService(tmp_path / "connectors.json")
    _install(
        monkeypatch,
        [
            _FakeStream(
                [
                    _chunk(
                        tool_calls=[
                            _tool_call('{"name":"gong","preset":"gong"}', name="add_connector")
                        ]
                    )
                ]

def test_unreachable_mcp_server_emits_one_error_event(monkeypatch) -> None:
    _install(monkeypatch, [])

"""Attachments become real model input, or an honest refusal."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from typing import Any

from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio import chat
from agentic_odi_studio_api.studio.schemas import (
    AttachmentRef,
    ChatMessage,
    ChatRequest,
)

from test_studio_chat_branches import _events, _install


def _request(*messages: ChatMessage, **overrides: Any) -> ChatRequest:
    values: dict[str, Any] = {
        "base_url": "http://llm/v1",
        "api_key": "key",
        "model": "model",
        "mcp_url": "http://mcp",
        "messages": list(messages),
    }
    values.update(overrides)
    return ChatRequest(**values)


def test_a_text_attachment_is_inlined_with_its_name() -> None:
    notes = AttachmentRef(
        name="interview.md",
        content_type="text/markdown",
        text="We cannot find the config key.",
    )

    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(
        _request(ChatMessage(role="user", content="summarise this"), attachments=[notes])
    )

    user = messages[-1]
    assert user["role"] == "user"
    assert "[interview.md]" in user["content"]
    assert "We cannot find the config key." in user["content"]


def test_a_text_attachment_is_truncated_when_too_long() -> None:
    huge = AttachmentRef(
        name="log.txt",
        content_type="text/plain",
        text="x" * (chat.MAX_ATTACHMENT_TEXT + 50),
    )

    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(
        _request(ChatMessage(role="user", content="read this"), attachments=[huge])
    )

    content = messages[-1]["content"]
    assert "x" * chat.MAX_ATTACHMENT_TEXT not in content
    assert "truncated" in content


def test_an_image_attachment_becomes_a_vision_part() -> None:
    image = AttachmentRef(
        name="screenshot.png",
        content_type="image/png",
        size=2048,
        data_url="data:image/png;base64,AAAA",
    )

    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(
        _request(ChatMessage(role="user", content="what is wrong here?"), attachments=[image])
    )

    user = messages[-1]
    assert user["role"] == "user"
    assert user["content"][0] == {"type": "text", "text": "what is wrong here?"}
    assert user["content"][1] == {
        "type": "image_url",
        "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64,AAAA"},
    }


def test_a_message_without_attachments_stays_plain() -> None:
    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(
        _request(ChatMessage(role="user", content="just words"))
    )

    assert messages[-1] == {"role": "user", "content": "just words"}


def test_attachments_are_merged_into_a_single_text_block() -> None:
    text_file = AttachmentRef(
        name="notes.md",
        content_type="text/markdown",
        text="Some notes.",
    )
    image = AttachmentRef(
        name="diagram.png",
        content_type="image/png",
        size=512,
        data_url="data:image/png;base64,BBBB",
    )

    messages = chat._to_openai_messages(
        _request(
            ChatMessage(role="user", content="look at these"),
            attachments=[text_file, image],
        )
    )

    user = messages[-1]
    assert user["role"] == "user"
    assert isinstance(user["content"], list)
    assert "[notes.md]" in user["content"][0]["text"]
    assert user["content"][1] == {
        "type": "image_url",
        "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64,BBBB"},
    }
